input: Research breathwork retreats within driving distance

gold.taskTitle: Research Breathwork Retreats Within Driving Distance
gold.taskDescription: Find and evaluate breathwork retreats that are reachable by car from the user's location.

questions.title: What city or region are you driving from?
questions.description: Establish the starting location to define what 'driving distance' means geographically.

questions.title: What maximum drive time feels acceptable to you?
questions.description: Determine the upper limit of travel time the user is willing to spend driving to a retreat.

questions.title: Are you looking for a day retreat or overnight stay?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a single-day experience or a multi-day residential retreat.

questions.title: Do you have a target month or date range in mind?
questions.description: Identify when the user wants to attend so results can be filtered by availability.

questions.title: Is there a specific breathwork style you prefer?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preference such as Holotropic, Wim Hof, Pranayama, or is open to any style.

questions.title: What is your approximate budget for the retreat?
questions.description: Establish a price range so options can be filtered to what is financially realistic for the user.

questions.title: Are you attending solo or bringing someone with you?
questions.description: Clarify group size to ensure the retreat format and accommodation options are a good fit.
